title: Introducing Smarter Sequences
summary: Meet Composer, built on what’s worked across 10M+ messages, plus more sending controls and clearer reporting, now live in Juicebox Sequences.
body_markdown:
##


**Introducing Smarter Sequences**


**Meet Composer, built on what’s worked across 10M+ messages, plus more sending controls and clearer reporting, now live in Juicebox Sequences.**


Getting candidates to reply is harder than ever. The best talent hears from recruiters every week, and generic outreach gets ignored. To stand out, every message needs to feel personal, follow what works, and land at the right moment, for every candidate on every req.


**Today we’re launching Smarter Sequences,** a set of updates that brings what’s worked across 10M+ messages into every sequence. Chat with Composer to draft and refine outreach, then send it with more control and see what’s landing.


###


**✍️ Draft and adapt with Composer**


*Build and refine any sequence by chatting, right where you source*


Gone are the days of one-shot prompts. Composer is your new copilot for building sequences, so you can chat your way to the perfect one. It starts from what it already knows about the role, recommends where to improve, and keeps refining with you until it sounds right.


-


**Start from context.** Composer pulls from your intake notes, project details, best-performing outreach, and tone.


-


**Answer a few questions.** Before the first draft, it checks who should send, how many steps to include, and which channels to use.


-


**Let it do the research.** Composer goes deep into your company, recent news, and media to give your outreach a more compelling hook.


-


**Refine in plain English.** Type "Drop in a recent interview with our CEO" or "Make it sound more personal," and the sequence updates in seconds.


What used to take an afternoon of rewrites now takes a few minutes of chat.


###


**✅ Apply best practices in every draft**


*Start every sequence from what gets replies*


Candidate outreach is often built on stale templates and practices. Our Composer applies what's worked across 10M+ messages, so every draft starts with proven structure, personalization, and timing already in place.


-


**Structure** that keeps messages short, clear, and easy to reply to.


-


**Personalization** that gives each candidate a reason to care.


-


**Timing** that spaces steps out so follow-ups land and don't pile up.


Want to know why a draft looks the way it does? Ask Composer "What best practices are behind this sequence?" and get a quick overview of what you're looking at.


Every sequence starts from a proven baseline, not a blank page. And as you build, Composer suggests improvements you can apply in a click.


###


**🎛 More control over every send**


*Choose what you send, when and from whom*


Better outreach takes more than a good message. You also need control over who you're sending to, who it comes from, and when it lands.


Starting today, you can:


-


Attach up to 3 files per email


-


Set your own unsubscribe wording (admin only)


-


Schedule around org-wide holidays and blackout dates (admin only)


-


Change the sender or timing for just the candidates you're adding


-


Enroll candidates without a phone number in sequences with call steps


Every send goes out the way you planned it.


###


**📊 See what's working**


*Know what lands, and how to act on it*


Without clear data, sequence copy is stuck relying on gut feel. Now, our new tracking capabilities let you follow each conversation from first send to meeting booked:


-


**Track performance by step** to see where candidates reply and where they drop off.


-


**Track replies across channels** in one view.


-


**Ask Composer what's worked.** Try "Which past messages got the best replies?" and use the answer in your next sequence.


See what's landing so you can double down on it.


###


**That's a wrap!**


Smarter Sequences is live today for every Juicebox customer. Open Sequences to try it, or[grab some time with our team](https://juicebox.ai/) for a walkthrough.


Want to learn more about what works best in candidate outreach?[We're unpacking it next week](https://juiceboxinc.wistia.com/live/events/f55f33rwm8) !
